item.title: 200 mayors rally to end classroom crisis
item.description: In a landmark “Bayanihan” summit, more than 200 mayors from across the Philippines gathered on Wednesday, January 28, to support a bold decentralization plan aimed at addressing the country’s chronic classroom shortage. item.title: PHA eyes expansion as Basulta has no assigned cardiologists
item.description: Cardiologists of the Philippine Heart Association (PHA) are seeking to expand specialist coverage in underserved provinces, particularly in Basilan, Sulu, and Tawi-Tawi ( Basulta), where no assigned cardiologists are currently available. item.title: Iligan jail shifts from punitive to reformative care
item.description: ILIGAN CITY — The Iligan City Jail–Male Dormitory is shifting away from a punitive incarceration model and adopting a reformative care approach that places rehabilitation, discipline, and personal development at the center of jail management. item.title: CHR supports push to decriminalize libel, cyberlibel
item.description: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY ― The Commission on Human Rights (CHR) is calling on Congress to decisively advance measures decriminalizing libel and cyberlibel, arguing that prison penalties have long been used to harass journalists and silence ordinary citizens. item.title: Metrobank Lowers InstaPay Fee to Just PHP8, Boosting Digital Payments
item.description: Metropolitan Bank & Trust Co. (Metrobank) has lowered its InstaPay transfer fee to PHP8 per transaction, its lowest rate yet, effective February 1, 2026—underscoring the Bank’s commitment to making digital banking more accessible and affordable for everyday Filipinos.
